authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.mission: ContextQuery, source adapters, retrieval/ranking/trust/freshness, minimal context, snapshots/invalidation, memory boundaries, semantic cache, safe speculation.

tasks.title: W06-00 Coordination / Context Boundary Freeze
actions: 1. Freeze context source, trust, freshness, tenant/classification and provenance boundaries.
2. Define ContextPack/MinimalContextPackage compatibility and cache authority rules.
3. Create context pressure/performance budget and poisoning/staleness threat plan.
tasks.forbidden: No W05 routing or W18 learning ownership.

tasks.title: W06-A ContextQuery + Source Adapters
actions: 1. Define ContextQuery contracts and adapters for approved source classes.
2. Propagate tenant/identity/classification/purpose constraints.
3. Do not fetch entire knowledge stores by default.

tasks.title: W06-B Retrieval / Ranking / Trust / Freshness Pipeline
actions: 1. Implement retrieval/ranking with provenance and source trust.
2. Validate freshness, conflicts, jurisdiction/consent constraints where applicable.
3. Represent uncertainty/conflicting facts explicitly.

tasks.title: W06-C Minimal Context Package + Compression
actions: 1. Compile minimal reproducible context for the task.
2. Track included/excluded sources, compression ratio and provenance.
3. Preserve critical constraints while reducing token/context pressure.
tasks.forbidden: Do not hide policy/authority requirements through compression.

tasks.title: W06-D ContextSnapshot Compiler + Incremental Invalidation
actions: 1. Define snapshot version/hash/freshness/provenance/invalidation triggers.
2. Support incremental recompilation/invalidation from W03 events.
3. Snapshot never freezes policy/authority.

tasks.title: W06-E Memory Boundary Model
actions: 1. Define working, episodic, semantic, company, user, temporal, operational and evidence memory boundaries.
2. Specify write/read ownership, retention/freshness and conflict semantics.
3. Use legacy memory taxonomy only as concept source.

tasks.title: W06-F Semantic Cache
actions: 1. Implement cache entries with query/result provenance, TTL, source versions and invalidation.
2. Define cache hit/miss/stale rejection semantics.
3. Cache may accelerate retrieval/reasoning only; never authority.

tasks.title: W06-G Safe Speculative Preparation
actions: 1. Implement prefetch/pre-rank/precompute for reversible read-only preparation.
2. Cancel/discard speculative work when context/policy changes.
3. Prove speculative path cannot perform external side effects.

tasks.title: W06-H Context Quality / Performance Tests
actions: 1. Prove same task can obtain minimal reproducible context.
2. Test stale/poisoned/conflicting sources and cache invalidation.
3. Measure ContextPack size, retrieval fan-out, cache metrics, invalidation lag, compression and p95/p99 assembly.
4. Verify tenant isolation under concurrency/cache.
